name: Arida (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Arida city emblem in orange: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter Y.
history: Municipal flag of Arida, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 April 1956.

features.role: Arida city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter Y
